stem: Which ending result or final point follows “Children under twelve can join the seed-planting activity for free.”?
options: Cars are not allowed inside River Park, but drivers can park at East Gate School and take the free market bus.
The rule did not make everyone happy, but it helped students remember that free time can be shared, not only scrolled.
Rules were still important, but the school learned that rules should leave room for understanding people's real lives.
It depends on gravity, light, water, air, and care-things people on Earth often take for granted.
